lines.say: The greatest goalscorer in history almost never became a professional.
lines.show: The greatest goalscorer in history almost never became a professional.

lines.say: his own heart threatened to end it all.
lines.show: his own *heart* threatened to end it all.

lines.say: It's nineteen-eighty-five. On the island of Madeira, a boy is born.
lines.show: It's 1985. On the island of Madeira, a boy is born.

lines.say: The family is poor. He shares a room with his siblings.
lines.show: The family is poor. He shares a room with his siblings.

lines.say: His father is the kit man at a small football club.
lines.show: His father is the kit man at a small football club.

lines.say: The boy plays in the street every day. Until late at night.
lines.show: The boy plays in the street every day. Until late at night.

lines.say: At twelve, he moves to Lisbon alone, to the Sporting academy.
lines.show: At 12, he moves to Lisbon alone, to the Sporting academy.

lines.say: He misses his family. At night, he often cries.
lines.show: He misses his family. At night, he often cries.

lines.say: Then, at fifteen, the shock. His heart is racing far too fast.
lines.show: Then, at 15, the *shock.* His heart is racing far too fast.

lines.say: His career is on the line. He needs surgery.
lines.show: His career is on the line. He needs surgery.

lines.say: Just days later, he is back on the pitch.
lines.show: Just days later, he is back on the pitch.

lines.say: At eighteen, he plays against Manchester United. So well that they sign him on the spot.
lines.show: At 18, he plays against Manchester United. So well that they sign him on the spot.

lines.say: Then come Real Madrid, five Ballon d'Ors and the European Championship with Portugal.
lines.show: Then come Real Madrid, *5* Ballon d'Ors and the European Championship with Portugal.

lines.say: He becomes the first player in history to score nine-hundred official goals.
lines.show: He becomes the first player in history to score *900* official goals.

lines.say: And the boy whose heart almost ended it all is Cristiano Ronaldo.
lines.show: And the boy whose heart almost ended it all is *Cristiano* *Ronaldo.*
